_comment: RigCheck by ShackDesk — protocol families for Find my radio. Each family names ONE probe operation from RigCheck's fixed, compiled, query-only set (KenwoodId, IcomReadId, IcomReadFreq, YaesuLegacyReadFreq) and the baud rates to sweep, most likely first. This file can never contain command bytes; it only chooses which built-in query to send. Weight orders families when nothing else hints; HamlibBackend is the thousands digit of the Hamlib model number (1 Yaesu, 2 Kenwood/Elecraft, 3 Icom). HandoffStopBits is what the operator should enter in WSJT-X — the probe itself always uses 8N1. Validate at jsonlint.com before submitting.
